name: What is the difference between a general market report and a specialized Waterfront Property Market Report?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a general market report and a specialized Waterfront Property Market Report?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general market report covers all residential properties in a given area, while a specialized Waterfront Property Market Report focuses exclusively on properties with direct water access or views. This distinction is vital because waterfront properties often have unique value drivers, such as bulkhead condition, depth of water access, or proximity to open ocean, which significantly impact their price. A specialized report provides a more accurate valuation by focusing on these specific characteristics relevant to locations like Key Biscayne or Williams Island, offering insights that a general report would miss.
acceptedAnswer.description: A specialized Waterfront Property Market Report focuses only on properties with water access, providing a more accurate valuation by analyzing unique features that influence their value, unlike general market reports.
